user.title: GWM add-on
user.description: Connect to a running GWM add-on. This is mostly useful for development or non-Supervisor installs.

data_description.host: Internal add-on hostname or development host.
data_description.port: Add-on API port. The packaged add-on uses 8099.
data_description.token: Generated add-on API token. GWM account credentials never go here.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure GWM add-on
reconfigure.description: Update the add-on API connection used by this integration. For normal Home Assistant add-on installs, restarting the add-on should rediscover and update these values automatically.

data_description.host: Internal add-on hostname or development host.
data_description.port: Add-on API port. The packaged add-on uses 8099.
data_description.token: Generated add-on API token. GWM account credentials never go here.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect GWM add-on
reauth_confirm.description: The add-on rejected the stored API token. Restart the add-on first; if this is a development install, enter the updated host, port, and token.

data_description.host: Internal add-on hostname or development host.
data_description.port: Add-on API port. The packaged add-on uses 8099.
data_description.token: Generated add-on API token. GWM account credentials never go here.

hassio_confirm.title: GWM add-on discovered
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the discovered GWM add-on at {host}.

error.invalid_auth: The add-on API token was rejected.

addon_auth_failed.message: The GWM add-on rejected the stored API token.

addon_request_failed.message: The GWM add-on could not complete the request.

addon_unavailable.message: The GWM add-on is not reachable.

remote_command_unavailable.message: Remote commands are unavailable. Enable remote commands and configure the security PIN in the add-on.

charging_control_unavailable.message: Charging control is unavailable. Enable charging control in the add-on and restart it.

invalid_climate_run_time.message: Climate run time must be a whole number from 5 to 30 minutes.

addon_auth_failed.title: GWM add-on authentication failed
addon_auth_failed.description: The integration can reach the GWM add-on, but the add-on rejected the stored API token. Restart the add-on first so Supervisor can rediscover it. For development or non-Supervisor installs, use Reconfigure and enter the current add-on API token.

set_charging_plan.name: Set charging plan
set_charging_plan.description: Set the vehicle's charging schedule. The car charges only inside the window; a window that starts in the future pauses charging until then. Requires enable_charging_control in the add-on.

vin.name: VIN
vin.description: The vehicle VIN as shown on the device (the readable serial, e.g. LGWEEUA57TR603334).

start_time.name: Start time
start_time.description: When charging may start. Set a future time to pause charging until then.

end_time.name: End time
end_time.description: When charging stops. The window must be at least 5 minutes.

clear_charging_plan.name: Clear charging plan
clear_charging_plan.description: Clear the vehicle's charging schedule so the car charges whenever it is plugged in.

vin.name: VIN
vin.description: The vehicle VIN, as shown on the device.
